notes: Every dropped lore book includes the target site's printed name.
Coordinates are rendered at drop time from the production-world site registry.
A full XYZ in one book is intentionally rare: 1.5%.
X+Z is also uncommon (4.5%) because it is enough to locate a site horizontally.
Missing axes are shown as [withheld] rather than omitted, making fragment matching obvious.
The fiction is that ordinary Covenant couriers carry divided waymarks so capture of one messenger does not reveal a complete strategic route.
Coordinate mode is rolled independently for every physical copy, so repeated copies of the same title can contain different coordinate fragments.
waymark_page_template: Compare copies bearing the same destination seal.
field_book_selection: If a strategic mob has home_source_id, 75% of field-book drops target its home site.
The remaining 25% target a random uncleared cult site.
For mobs without a home source, choose a random uncleared cult site.
After a site is cleared, reduce its ordinary clue weight to a small historical residue (suggested 5%) so players are not flooded with obsolete coordinates.
sealed_archive_selection: Each sealed capital fragment belongs to one origin site.
It may drop only from enemies assigned to that site's bounds/strategic source.
Give it a very low ordinary elite-drop chance if desired.
Guarantee first acquisition when that site's Source Core is cleared, implemented by the site's surviving/triggered elite bearer or other enemy drop path.
Border opening still requires the intended Source Core clears, so an unusually early archive drop cannot skip the campaign.
